q: Which age group has the most cases in women?
Women 1650, men 540: about 3 times higher in women.
Suggest why more cases are found in young women than young men.
Young women are tested more often (screening, clinics); men more often have no symptoms and are not tested.
Use the data to recommend who a screening campaign should target, with a reason.
People aged 15-24, both sexes: highest rates. Free, easy testing for young men would find hidden cases, as they may be under-counted.
